REPLACEMENT_MECHANISM.statement: The half-shift alpha=(1/2,0,0) Poisson-dualizes to the alternating character (-1)^n1. The character annihilates every ODD shell of the transverse square dual lattice, exactly, by the orientation-reversing coordinate swap (k1,k2)->(k2,k1). That swap exists only when the transverse sides are equal, i.e. only on the cube. The residue is the surviving sqrt2-tower.
